description: This file defines various enumerations, structures, types, and class interfaces for device settings, media configurations, display management, front panel indicators, and remote procedure call (RPC) stubs. It appears to be part of a hardware abstraction layer or device management SDK, containing declarations for input/output ports, audio formats, resolutions, HDMI, EDID, HDCP, sleep modes, and other device controls.
